purpose: Source-visible noncoplanar white-target stripe lines for a direct pinhole camera diagnostic. The orange rim is deliberately excluded and reserved as independent held-out 3D evidence.
annotation_policy: Native 960x540 pixels only. Line samples were taken from local brightness/RGB ridges on the visible 2-inch white target stripe. No solver residual, cross-camera transfer, generated pixels, player or ball geometry was used.

metric_line_model.note: The 2-inch stripe is represented by its centreline, exactly analogous to the v83 painted-court-line correction. The outer lower target edge is at ring-top height in the project NBA basket geometry; v87 does not use rim pixels in the fit.

seed_only_corner_estimates_px.note: Approximate intersections used only to initialize PnP; excluded from all residuals and gates.

held_out_policy: All orange-rim pixels and geometry are held out from v87. No rim observation is present in this file.
